content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the agreement — the Personnel and Freedom of Action clauses are the only personnel/restraint provisions, and neither restricts hiring or solicitation.

input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, anti-poaching, or no-hire covenant. Section 14.8 (Personnel) addresses only supervision, assignment, and subcontracting, and § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", and personnel-related restrictions returned no restrictive covenant anywhere in the document. Customer therefore bears no non-solicitation restriction, which meets the preferred position; no redline is needed.

mappings.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
